items.title: Spurs 'lack confidence' but we are a good team - De Zerbi
items.summary: Tottenham Hotspur head coach Roberto de Zerbi hails the spirit and attitude of his side following their first Premier League win of the season, as they beat Coventry City.

items.title: Lampard 'proud' of Coventry performance in defeat by Spurs
items.summary: Coventry City manager Frank Lampard says he is proud of his side's performance, despite losing at struggling Tottenham Hotspur in the Premier League.
